subject: Trial orchestration: success metrics, owners & weekly cadence
messages:
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Miller <ben.miller@clearwave.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 14:05:00 -0800
Subject: Post-call recap & proposed trial orchestration

Ben — thanks again for taking the demo today. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we can get the trial moving without friction.

Summary of what we heard from your side:
- Goal: reduce inference cost for your triage assistant and cut average response latency from ~420ms to <150ms for 95th pct.
- Success users: internal care team + pilot subset of 200 daily sessions.
- Constraints: PHI-adjacent logs (no raw PII in transit), on-cloud deployment (GCP us-west), two-week decision window after readout.

Proposed trial plan (high level):
1) Kickoff (Week 0): technical onboarding, data contract & minimal ingestion test.
2) Week 1: baseline capture (current calls, latency/cost metrics) + initial model mapping and config.
3) Week 2: optimize batching/quantization profile, run A/B with 10% traffic.
4) Week 3: full pilot on reserved capacity, cost/readout dashboards enabled.
5) Week 4: final readout + go/no-go decision.

Key success criteria (proposed — please confirm):
- Production-like latency: p95 < 150ms for pilot traffic.
- Cost target: >= 30% reduction in per-token cost vs current endpoint.
- Functional parity: >= 95% of top-10 prompts return acceptable answers per your rubric.
- Operational: logs & audit hooks present; SOC2-compatible evidence for the evaluation window.

Owners / responsibilities:
- Redwood (Kimberly): overall trial orchestration, weekly readout.
- Redwood (Marissa): infra & model tuning; point for quant/latency work.
- Clearwave (Ben): data access approvals, stakeholder communication.
- Clearwave (Priya): success rubric + acceptance for final readout.

Immediate asks / next steps:
- Can we lock kickoff for Monday, Dec 14? (30–60 min)
- Please share the sample dataset access method or a test payload (S3/GCS link or curlable endpoint).
- Review and confirm the success criteria above; flag anything missing.

Attachments: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (attached) — includes milestone schedule, security checklist, and minimal data contract.

If that looks good I’ll send calendar invites for kickoff and weekly check-ins (Tues 10am PT working time slot).

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
kimberly.park@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: redwood-poc-plan-v1.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Ben Miller <ben.miller@clearwave.com>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Sharma <priya.sharma@clearwave.com>
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 16:12:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed trial orchestration

Kimberly — thanks for the crisp summary. We like the structure and targets. A few clarifications from our side before we lock kickoff: 

1) Data access — we can provide a GCS test bucket (read-only) with anonymized session payloads by EOD Monday. Will that work for the baseline capture?
2) PHI handling — our security team needs to confirm that any logs retained by Redwood during the trial will be strictly metadata-only. Can Marissa share the retention and redaction approach?
3) Timeline — Monday Dec 14 kickoff is tight for internal approvals; could we do Tuesday Dec 15 morning instead?

Priya — looping you in to confirm the success rubric items (latency/cost/functional parity).

Ben
Director, Product Ops | Clearwave Health
ben.miller@clearwave.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Miller <ben.miller@clearwave.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>
Cc: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed trial orchestration — tech details and retention

Ben — appreciate the questions. Quick responses: 

- GCS read-only bucket is perfect — please send a path and a service-account with read-only permissions. We will only pull anonymized payloads you provide.
- Retention & redaction: Redwood will not persist raw PHI. During the trial we keep token-level metadata and model-output hashes for evaluation. Any logs with identifiers will be redacted; we can provide our redaction script and a short SOC2-aligned description.
- Data access checklist: I attached an editable checklist to speed approvals.

Proposed kickoff: Tuesday, Dec 15 at 10:00am PT — 45 min. Agenda: 1) introductions, 2) data access walk-through, 3) measurement/observability plan, 4) Q&A.

Dylan — can you confirm who on infra will own the reserved capacity and setup, and estimate a <24h prep window once we have bucket access?

Thanks — Marissa
Marissa Cole
Principal Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
marissa.cole@redwood.ai

---
Attachment: clearwave-data-checklist.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)
From: Dylan Brooks <dylan.brooks@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwood.ai>, Ben Miller <ben.miller@clearwave.com>
Date: Mon, 14 Dec 2026 10:02:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap & proposed trial orchestration — infra owner & prep

Confirming infra plan:
- Owner: Dylan Brooks (Redwood infra) — I’ll spin a short-lived dedicated instance pool in us-west with the quantization profile Marissa recommends.
- Prep window: once we have GCS read-only credentials and a small sample payload, we can be ready within 12–18 hours.
- Monitoring: I will enable the per-route token breakdown dashboard and a p95 latency alert to the Redwood/Clearwave shared PagerDuty (read-only for Clearwave).

Ben — please share the GCS path and the SOC/POC contact; we’ll take it from there.

Thanks,
Dylan
Dylan Brooks
Staff Infra Engineer | Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 15 Dec 2026 09:30:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Trial orchestration: success metrics, owners & weekly cadence — confirm

Kimberly / Marissa / Dylan — confirmed on our side. A few additions to the success rubric and cadence: 

- Functional parity: we’ll provide a 10-scenario acceptance test + labeling rubric; pass threshold 95% as you suggested.
- Readout stakeholders: myself, Ben, and two clinical SMEs (Dr. R. Patel, Sara Nguyen). They will attend the final readout.
- Weekly cadence: Tuesdays 10:00am PT weekly check-ins are good. Please include a short pre-read (1 page) 24h ahead of each check-in that contains key metrics (p95 latency, tokens, cost delta, error rates).

We’ll share the GCS link by 2pm PT today and give a service-account with read-only. Looking forward to the kickoff.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Product | Clearwave Health
priya.sharma@clearwave.com

Thanks — great to have everything aligned. I’ve sent calendar invites for: 
- Kickoff: Tue Dec 15, 10:00am–10:45am PT (Zoom link in invite)
- Weekly check-ins: Tuesdays 10:00am PT (30 min recurring; first readout check-in scheduled Dec 22)

Pre-kickoff deliverables (what we’ll have ready):
- Redwood: pre-read (1 pager) with measurement plan, trial milestones, dashboard links, and a short checklist for the sample payload (will send 24h before kickoff).
- Clearwave: GCS test bucket with anonymized payload + service-account (Ben/Priya to share).

I’ve uploaded the final PoC plan and the editable data checklist to the shared drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-redwood-clearwave-poc

If anything changes please flag and we’ll adjust. Looking forward to getting started.

Best,
